data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 contradicts SRC_002 because SRC_003 asserts the result as a direct arithmetic fact (300 pages) without establishing the uniqueness of the solution, while SRC_002 explicitly depends on the strict monotonicity of D(n) to prove that 300 is the unique solution rather than merely a feasible one. It is refuted if SRC_003's derivation implicitly assumes uniqueness through the arithmetic partition without requiring a separate monotonicity argument—in that case, the contradiction collapses into a difference in explicitness rather than substance.
